answer: A zephyr-carried ledge delta courier oath keeps fake agents out. First, each newcomer stakes 200 POA and registers a 90-dollar hardware key, then completes five supervised deliveries across a river delta, each signed by a different ledge keeper. Second, keepers verify the cargo before stamping the record. Third, a failed audit burns the stake and bans the key for 150 days. Forging 1,000 identities would cost 200,000 POA, 90,000 dollars, and 5,000 staged deliveries. Like a mountain trail that trusts only couriers it has watched cross the ledge, the delta stays open to the honest.
